scope: Exact locally calibrated experimental profiles and original interoperability references. Native factory is authoritative; catalog alone grants no flight permission.
promotionRule: An exact variant needs a current source-bound short-test receipt before its status is changed. A historical baseline is not a new clearance-code test.
